approach: A1 → A2 path, following the topics of the official Russian state exam for foreigners (TORFL / ТРКИ, Elementary then Basic level). Each day: about 10 high-frequency words, one grammar step, example sentences with pictures and voice, then spaced-repetition cards. Phrases first, grammar explained inside them.

days.title: Me, you, him: pronouns and “I have” (у меня́ есть)
Everyday verbs: live, work, study, speak
Time and days of the week
Food and the café: хочу́, мо́жно
In the city: where is…? (в / на + prepositional)
What did you do? Past tense
Body and health: у меня́ боли́т…
Hobbies and sport: люблю́ / игра́ть в…
Review: a short story with everything so far
Motion verbs with prefixes: прийти́, уйти́, вы́йти
Instrumental in use: with, become, be interested in
Talking about the past: when, how long, ago (наза́д)
